name: Half Roll-Back
description: Sitting tall with knees bent and arms reaching forward, curve your spine into a C and roll back part-way, then scoop your abs to come back up.

source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words (no band: the classic mat version, e.g. onlinepilatesclasses.com "Half Roll Back on the Mat"). Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Sit tall with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Reach your arms forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
cues: Tuck your tailbone and make a smooth C shape.
Roll back only as far as you can keep your feet down and your back curved.
Use your stomach, not your arms, to come back up.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Sit tall
keyframes.cue: Knees bent, feet flat, arms reaching forward.

keyframes.name: Roll back
keyframes.cue: Curve into a C and roll back halfway.
